# ankra_ai_lane_model (Resource)

The model one AI lane (a platform function such as stack README generation or AI code review) runs on. The counterpart of `ankra ai lanes set` and `ankra ai lanes clear`; `ankra ai lanes list` names the lanes. Destroying it returns the lane to its default tier. A lane cleared outside Terraform is planned for re-creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_lane_model" "code_review" {
  lane      = "code_review"
  model_key = "expert"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `lane` (String) Lane name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `model_key` (String) Catalogue key (`ankra_ai_model.key`) or an exact OpenRouter model id the lane runs on.

### Read-Only

- `default_tier` (String) Tier the lane falls back to without a selection.
- `effective_model_id` (String) Model id the lane runs on now.
- `effective_model_name` (String) Display name of the model the lane runs on now.
- `id` (String) The lane name.
- `is_selection_stale` (Boolean) Whether the selection no longer resolves (for example its catalogue entry was deleted), so the lane runs on its default.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Lane models are imported by lane name (ankra ai lanes list).
terraform import ankra_ai_lane_model.code_review code_review
```
